completion_decisions: Retain direction-only and Scenarios I-IV as five distinct paper-native problem roles.
Use the full published Zhan APSO mechanism, not a generic PSO label.
Digitize the published 12 by 5 wind rose and map missing time-indexed Opt4 to 80 turbines by 60 states.
Retain partial-overlap Jensen/RSS wakes, NREL 5 MW physics, hierarchical cable losses, LPC, pitch penalty and all published bounds.
Use a rotor-feasible MPPT controller plus declared extra-pitch control and Table-II calibrated missing engineering coefficients.
Parallelize particle evaluation/update and the exact symmetric APSO distance matrix with counter-keyed events and ordered reductions.
Run the paper-native 10 plus four times 20 repeat protocol on Waffle after H6.
missing_information: cable coefficients, current limits, OAM, rate and lifetime
target CP(beta,lambda), CT and optimized dispatch arrays
beta maximum, TE, Num_c and optimized row/column intervals
direction-only maximum iterations and velocity bound

paper.authors: Peng Hou and Weihao Hu and Mohsen Soltani and Cong Chen and Baohua Zhang and Zhe Chen
paper.title: Offshore Wind Farm Layout Design Considering Optimized Power Dispatch Strategy

paper_source_conflicts: Opt4 is time-indexed but the paper publishes only an aggregated 60-state wind rose.
Table III says 10-trial averages while the scenario text says the program is run 20 times.

public_asset_candidate_evidence.status: no_target_public_source; three cited institutional predecessor assets audited

scope.claim_boundary: academic flexible reconstruction of APSO and all five paper-native problem roles; not author code, native FINO3/cable/control arrays, random stream, or numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: 504--2520 m gaps, -90--90 degree rotation, bounded additional pitch, NREL rotor speed, right-branch CP condition and published penalty

decision_variables.resolution: 1, 16, 17, 4800 and 4817 dimensions across the five paper roles

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: direct row/column gaps and theta; Opt4 is decoded as per-turbine/per-published-wind-state pitch beyond MPPT

initialization.resolution: paper bounds and populations, zero-dispatch incumbent, sparse extra-pitch perturbations and deterministic counter RNG

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: gross/loss/net energy, cable and annual costs, LPC, penalty, timings, FES, worker receipt and hash; 10 direction plus 20 per scenario

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize levelized production cost including energy, hierarchical losses, cable capital and OAM

paper_native_cases.resolution: direction-only and Scenarios I, II, III and IV are separately registered

parameters.resolution: paper populations/iterations, 50-unchanged stop, exact Zhan APSO adaptation and ELS, 20-percent velocity limit

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: role maximum or 50 unchanged iterations; every complete 80-turbine 60-state evaluation is one FES

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: T68 APSO has no learned model

update_order.resolution: ESE, parameter adaptation, convergence-state ELS, simultaneous velocity/position update, parallel evaluation and ordered personal/global-best commit

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: partial Jensen/RSS, NREL 5 MW CP/CT completion, hierarchical collection/export loss and Table-II anchored LPC

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: normalized digitization of 12 directional sectors and five 5-m/s bins
